findings.text: the retuned source-comparison question fails the keep-bar the plan set for it and must not land as it stands: the node's own replay scores recall on the planted contradictions at 32 of 60 against 60 of 60 for the old question (srtj-contradiction-veto-retune.json bar.recall_new/recall_old), and 6 of the recorded firings still fire against a ceiling of 3 (bar.recorded_still_fire_new), so merging this change suppresses 28 genuine contradictions while failing to clear the false firings it was retuned for; the node reports this itself and the coordinator should hold it rather than promote it.

the evidence fragment's own numbers do not reconcile with the JSON it describes: line 44-45 reads 'the stored (name, claim, DD text) triples, 34 after deduplication' where the runner's dedup key yields 46 rows and srtj-contradiction-veto-retune.json reports 46, and line 85 reads '228 calls (114 states, two arms each)' where the runner judged three sets of 46, 60 and 20 states (46+60+20=126) twice; both look like numbers carried over from an earlier draft and are wrong as written.

the assertion 'verdict["contradiction_veto"] is False' moves with the value under test: fake_decide_batch in the same test supplies only 'says nothing' answers, so the veto is False whatever the production predicate does, and reverting label_only_source to False would leave this line green; the test's real guard is its final assertion at :157, and this line should not be counted as coverage of the retune.

the fragment reports a before/after bar table with no figure, and the declared write path docs/figures/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-contradiction-veto-retune was never written, although every sibling fragment of this plan carries one (docs/figures/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-docs-score-arm/paired-auc.svg and thirteen others); the user mandate makes a graphic the expectation for a measurement document and the node had fenced itself the path to place it.
